issue.title: Bug:  Installing sonic-ctrmgrd on Docker-only systems introduces multiple errors to the log

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Following merge of https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23963 including commit: [Always install sonic-ctrmgrd wheel into host](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23963/commits/e1b18f45303de5cfa13c561dc2192fbc592f676f)

There are multiple errors in the log as shown in the log below. Those 'Skip to tag feature' errors are caused since ctrmgr_tools is installed unconditionally - also on Docker-only deployments.
This happens because of the following if statement:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/9012f01227e527df4d6a0c0e0a0a6586d2429904/src/sonic-ctrmgrd/ctrmgr/ctrmgr_tools.py#L77
This error will be always returned since owner in Docker-only deployments is not "kube".

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Build image for non Kubernetes system, i.e.: compile with INCLUDE_KUBERNETES = n (default).
2. Run fast-reboot or 'reboot -t'

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior:
Multiple 'Skip to tag feature' errors in the log as shown in the log messages below.

Expected behavior:
No 'Skip to tag feature' errors in the log.
